title: Small-Batch FP16 GEMM Kernels — Triton, CuTe DSL and cuBLASLt on RTX 4090

workstreams.title: FP16 GEMM numerical gates and paired timing on RTX 4090
workstreams.summary: Single-GPU small-batch FP16 GEMM and bias+SiLU qualification on an RTX 4090 24 GB (sm_89, CUDA 13.2, C++17, Python 3.13, torch 2.13.0, Triton 3.7.1, CuTe DSL 4.6.1) with an independent CPU FP64 oracle, explicit fallbacks for unsupported CuTe layouts and bounded, failure-aware experiment execution; 76 GPU comparison records and 86 native CUDA tests are retained, including slower paths. At M=32, N=K=4096, timed with the B matrix resident in L2, the measured p50 was 18.0 μs for cuBLASLt, 20.7 μs for Triton and 18.5 μs for CuTe, so no cuBLASLt win is claimed.
bullets: Benchmarked FP16 GEMMs against cuBLAS (cuBLASLt) at M=32, N=K=4096 on a single RTX 4090, timed back-to-back with the B matrix resident in L2: p50 was 18.0 μs for cuBLASLt, 18.5 μs for CuTe DSL and 20.7 μs for Triton, with fused bias/SiLU compared only against an equal-semantics GEMM+bias+SiLU baseline.

Timed FP16 GEMM and bias+SiLU linear fragments on a single RTX 4090 24 GB (sm_89; CUDA, Python, PyTorch, Triton and CuTe DSL) across M=1/8/32/128 with N=K=4096, running correctness and sanitizer checks before 20 warmups and 31 randomized AB/BA CUDA-event pairs with data resident on GPU; all 76 GPU comparison records and 86 native CUDA tests are retained, including the slower paths and fallbacks.

Built an independent numerical gate for M=32, N=K=4096 that shares no GPU dispatch path with the candidates: pre-quantized FP16 inputs, a full CPU FP64 output reference, 64 dots cross-checked with independent scalar accumulation, a tolerance of abs <= 0.02 + 0.002 x |reference|, and poison-padding plus output-canary checks; 8 additional boundary probes (zero M, zero K, tail N, tail K and 4 strided inputs) stayed separate from the historical 76 records.

Kept unsupported layouts explicit: the aligned CuTe path accepts only selected K/N alignment while strided and empty inputs take a reported explicit fallback, and the sm_89 path does not use TMA or WGMMA.

Hardened local experiment execution against hung and racing runs: a hung child that spawned a cooperative worker was terminated as a whole process group after timeout, leaving only a failure receipt; atomic run-directory admission let only one of two publishers claim a run ID; and a file-lock-based GPU lock covered the entire qualification stage.
